answer: One mechanism is a bonded identity lattice: each agent registers against a human-backed credential and locks a stake maturing as slowly as a glacier, so spinning up thousands of sock puppets means fronting thousands of deposits instead of one cheap signup. Reputation travels as a ripple across the attestation graph, since agents vouch only for peers they have actually transacted with, forcing any fake cluster to fake real trade. Identity becomes a pearl that is costly to counterfeit and easy to verify.
